question: Can the fixed Gnomix anchor train and infer reproducibly on all 79791 B0 markers within protected resources before TARGET truth is opened?

source_panel.truth_policy: No truth file or mosaic-event file is an input. ASIA must not be relabelled as NAM.

subset.selection: All authenticated B0 markers in original order; no subsampling or TARGET-based filtering.

gnomix_parameters.rationale: Carry forward the historical/default anchor unchanged. No screen is permitted before TARGET predictions and the scoring contract are frozen.

terminal_partition.policy: Gnomix trains W=371 base models; the terminal model consumes M plus the 26 residual markers. MSP counts must sum to all 79791 markers.

execution.launch_order: Run A alone, audit its resource trace, and launch B only after A passes every gate.
execution.ordering: Each model is serialized, audited and hashed before its corresponding TARGET inference process starts.
execution.internal_validation_policy: Preserve Gnomix internal synthetic-validation artifacts but do not inspect or use their values for progression or claims.

gates.F0_AUTH: All input, config, code, runtime-audit and container hashes match.
gates.F1_FULL_INPUT: Exactly 79791 ordered B0 markers and all expected phased REF/TARGET samples are retained.
gates.F2_RESIDUAL_POLICY: Runtime derives M=215, W=371, context=107 and assigns 241 markers to the terminal window, for 79791 modeled markers total.
gates.F3_BOUNDARY: Training receives no TARGET, truth, mosaic events, BR or BS.
gates.F4_MODEL: The replica trains and serializes the fixed three-ancestry architecture without nonfinite state.
gates.F5_INFERENCE: Inference retains 30 targets, 371 windows, all 79791 markers, AFR/EUR/ASIA and normalized finite probabilities.
gates.F6_RESOURCES: The replica stays at or below 19.2 GiB RSS and 48 minutes.
gates.F7_REPRODUCIBILITY: After B, generated training data hashes are exact, MSP is exact and FB max absolute difference is at most 1e-10.
gates.F8_SCOPE: No TARGET truth, accuracy, effect, screen, BR/BS, NAM or real-DNABR claim is produced.

stop_rule: Any failed gate stops. Do not launch B unless A passes F0-F6. Do not resize, retry, inspect truth or change scientific parameters inside this contract.
